subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “To others, it was only folded paper.”?
options: "You try, fail, change something, and try again."
To Alan, it was proof that trying again can change the shape of failure.
Some objects survive best when communities allow them to change purpose while keeping their recognizable shape.
Sometimes it means choosing which parts must remain and which parts must change so a place can live again.
